entries.title: I Samuel 23:1
segments: ¶Then they told David, saying, "Look, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah, and they are robbing the threshing floors."

entries.title: I Samuel 23:2
segments: Therefore David inquired of the LORD, saying, "Shall I go and attack these Philistines?" And the LORD said to David, "Go and attack the Philistines, and save Keilah."

entries.title: I Samuel 23:3
segments: But David's men said to him, "Look, we are afraid here in Judah. How much more then if we go to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?"

entries.title: I Samuel 23:4
segments: Then David inquired of the LORD once again. And the LORD answered him and said, "Arise, go down to Keilah. For I will deliver the Philistines into your hand."

entries.title: I Samuel 23:5
segments: And David and his men went to Keilah and fought with the Philistines, struck them with a mighty blow, and took away their livestock. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.

entries.title: I Samuel 23:6
segments: Now it happened, when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David at Keilah, [that] he went down [with] an ephod in his hand.

entries.title: I Samuel 23:7
segments: ¶And Saul was told that David had gone to Keilah. So Saul said, "God has delivered him into my hand, for he has shut himself in by entering a town that has gates and bars."

entries.title: I Samuel 23:8
segments: Then Saul called all the people together for war, to go down to Keilah to besiege David and his men.

entries.title: I Samuel 23:9
segments: When David knew that Saul plotted evil against him, he said to Abiathar the priest, "Bring the ephod here."

entries.title: I Samuel 23:10
segments: Then David said, "O LORD God of Israel, Your servant has certainly heard that Saul seeks to come to Keilah to destroy the city for my sake.

entries.title: I Samuel 23:11
segments: "Will the men of Keilah deliver me into his hand? Will Saul come down, as Your servant has heard? O LORD God of Israel, I pray, tell Your servant." And the LORD said, "He will come down."

entries.title: I Samuel 23:12
segments: Then David said, "Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul?" And the LORD said, "They will deliver [you]."

entries.title: I Samuel 23:13
segments: So David and his men, about six hundred, arose and departed from Keilah and went wherever they could go. Then it was told Saul that David had escaped from Keilah; so he halted the expedition.

entries.title: I Samuel 23:14
segments: ¶And David stayed in strongholds in the wilderness, and remained in the mountains in the Wilderness of Ziph. Saul sought him every day, but God did not deliver him into his hand.

entries.title: I Samuel 23:15
segments: So David saw that Saul had come out to seek his life. And David [was] in the Wilderness of Ziph in a forest.

entries.title: I Samuel 23:16
segments: Then Jonathan, Saul's son, arose and went to David in the woods and strengthened his hand in God.

entries.title: I Samuel 23:17
segments: And he said to him, "Do not fear, for the hand of Saul my father shall not find you. You shall be king over Israel, and I shall be next to you. Even my father Saul knows that."

entries.title: I Samuel 23:18
segments: So the two of them made a covenant before the LORD. And David stayed in the woods, and Jonathan went to his own house.

entries.title: I Samuel 23:19
segments: ¶Then the Ziphites came up to Saul at Gibeah, saying, "Is David not hiding with us in strongholds in the woods, in the hill of Hachilah, which [is] on the south of Jeshimon?

entries.title: I Samuel 23:20
segments: "Now therefore, O king, come down according to all the desire of your soul to come down; and our part [shall be] to deliver him into the king's hand."

entries.title: I Samuel 23:21
segments: And Saul said, "Blessed [are] you of the LORD, for you have compassion on me.

entries.title: I Samuel 23:22
segments: "Please go and find out for sure, and see the place where his hideout is, [and] who has seen him there. For I am told he is very crafty.

entries.title: I Samuel 23:23
segments: "See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hides; and come back to me with certainty, and I will go with you. And it shall be, if he is in the land, that I will search for him throughout all the clans of Judah."

entries.title: I Samuel 23:24
segments: So they arose and went to Ziph before Saul. But David and his men [were] in the Wilderness of Maon, in the plain on the south of Jeshimon.

entries.title: I Samuel 23:25
segments: When Saul and his men went to seek [him], they told David. Therefore he went down to the rock, and stayed in the Wilderness of Maon. And when Saul heard [that], he pursued David in the Wilderness of Maon.

entries.title: I Samuel 23:26
segments: Then Saul went on one side of the mountain, and David and his men on the other side of the mountain. So David made haste to get away from Saul, for Saul and his men were encircling David and his men to take them.

entries.title: I Samuel 23:27
segments: But a messenger came to Saul, saying, "Hasten and come, for the Philistines have invaded the land!"

entries.title: I Samuel 23:28
segments: Therefore Saul returned from pursuing David, and went against the Philistines; so they called that place the Rock of Escape.

entries.title: I Samuel 23:29
segments: Then David went up from there and dwelt in strongholds at En Gedi.
